summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K by Bitzero Holdings Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three months ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications. No corporate transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or special situation is disclosed. The document is purely an earnings report with standard financial statement exhibits.
